title: Audio Memo Voiced Event
description: The inbox watcher rendered one sentence-chunk of a memo's reply and uploaded it for the car (replies/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<HHMMSS>Z-<agent>-<memo_id>-c<ii>of<nn>.opus in holocene-auto, Ogg/Opus, never the Earshot bucket), so the car starts speaking the first sentence while the rest of the reply renders. A reply longer than about 160 spoken characters is split at sentence boundaries into chunks that grow (about 110, 170, then 300 characters); they render one after the other and each is announced as soon as it is up. The full reply (the chunks joined) still goes up afterwards as replies/...-<memo_id>.ogg and is announced by bloodbank.audio.memo.replied, which also carries reply_chunks, first_chunk_seconds and last_chunk_seconds. Published once per chunk, also across a speak-stage retry. Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

command_id.description: command_id of the turn whose reply this is.

spoken_text.description: What was sent to TTS for this chunk (the first chunk starts with the agent's name).

reply_s3_key.description: The reply of record this chunk belongs to: replies/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<HHMMSS>Z-<agent>-<memo_id>.ogg (uploaded after the last chunk).

chunk_s3_key.description: Object key of this chunk: the reply key without .ogg, plus -c<ii>of<nn>.opus.

chunk.description: 1..chunks: this chunk's place in the reply.

chunks.description: How many chunks the reply is spoken in.

since_reply_seconds.description: Seconds from the watcher finding the reply text to this chunk being up.

since_agent_done_seconds.description: Seconds from the watcher seeing the agent's turn finish to this chunk being up.

late.description: The reply is spoken as a late reply.
